rationale.consistency: Mirrors CookieFilter's structure, module ID pattern, action types, OUTER-label loop and interface guards; minor receiver-name mix (f vs m).
rationale.edge_cases: Handles unparsable lines, no-attribute lines, quoted replace, exact-name match, delete; leading whitespace before name would be dropped on rewrite, and quoted hash loses quoting (acceptable).
rationale.scope: Only adds the new filter, registration and guards; no unrelated edits.
rationale.readability: Clear flow; suffix preservation via strings.Cut is obvious; doc comment states first-match semantics.
rationale.robustness: No panics; non-array fields pass through; default switch arm safely passes line through.
rationale.maintainability: UnmarshalCaddyfile is a verbatim copy of CookieFilter's; a shared helper would avoid drift between the two filters.
